assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only azur-lane:baltimore@mobile-game#azur-lane-baltimore-character-monograph, the canonical frozen V1 monograph AZUR_LANE_BALTIMORE_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the pinned CN-origin Azur Lane client corpus (build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf): 72 clean direct-presence narrative scenes and 276 clean narrative dialogue records after the nine-scene identity quarantine, the four-part memory, 105 character-dialogue records, social threads and JP/EN/TW/KR regional witnesses as the monograph summarizes them. The R2-R8 specialist files, the relationship-state, multilingual-speech and JP voice-performance profiles, the claim ledger and the audits it routes to are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The project's readiness grade A, score 82.91 and simulator-status labels are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection and no audio audition.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The live-service game has no single story chronology. The monograph orders Baltimore only by Commander relationship stage (CMD0 professional authority through CMD5 self-authored committed intimacy) and by situational state (S0-S9); its named episodes (the miwuzhixia memory trap, the Bremerton rest material, Fleet Chat decorum, Memphis and Hornet engagements) are not itemized by record ID or event date. Claims cover the corpus pinned at the build above; content released after that build is outside the boundary.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: An explicit decision architecture (notice, check, separate known from inferred, test viability, allocate competence, commit, repair) with a weighted motive hierarchy (M1 protection through M8 weak image concern) and ten named states that say what changes the response: accepted responsibility raises effort, a credible endangered person expands the risk budget, live challenge raises forward pressure, a culpable aggressor raises punitive urgency, clear nonviability ends the attack path, and an externally scripted intimate identity produces self-monitoring. It predicts her errors (F2 challenge overextension as the clearest observed margin loss, F3 reasoned but wrong calls with the miwuzhixia trap as counterexample, F4 hawkishness beyond the strategic frame). Its R5 outcomes are stated per hypothesis, including the H10 downgrade of severe anger-driven overextension to medium confidence. Not A: the account is one unlocated synthesis and a severe clash between legitimate authority and protective justice is left open.

Change is modeled as Commander relationship stages CMD0-CMD5 with one stated asymmetry (security and embodied comfort rise more smoothly than romantic-role or ceremonial fluency) and an integration trajectory at mature stages. A gacha game supplies no narrative chronology for her non-Commander life, and the monograph keeps no event-ordered state record. Stage conditioning is supported; development over time outside the Commander axis is not.

Semantic speech functions are given per state (question-driven before commitment, short and forceful in combat, sharper under moral anger, concrete in care, teasing in self-authored flirtation, broken under scripted romance) with eight negative constraints, including no constant catchphrases and no justice as filler. Locale realization is delegated to the R7 profile and performed voice to the JP profile, neither on the row; the monograph quotes no line in any locale. It constrains function and register direction, not wording.

S0 baseline activity and the leisure section give ordinary behavior: activity-oriented initiation around a shared subject, volunteering, sport, food, travel, social media, hosting, and public-channel decorum. These are tendencies without located scenes, and the corpus composition warning (COMMANDER_HEAVY) means ordinary material is weighted toward Commander-facing secretary and dorm contexts.

The Commander is decomposed into simultaneous roles (strategic authority, protected principal, collaborator, activity partner, audience, romantic target) across six stages, and named peers get distinct modifiers: Bremerton reciprocal calibration with indirect practical intervention, Memphis as an analytical brake overridden only with a stated reason, Enterprise as respected expert she can still challenge, Hornet as an activation amplifier she first warns against. The monograph states where the conditioning stops (non-Commander romance C5, Commander-heavy composition not to define global personality). Detailed stage evidence lives in the off-row R6 synthesis.

Destabilizers are mapped by direction (anger narrows toward punishment, challenge raises enthusiasm, danger to a protected person raises urgency, scripted intimacy raises self-monitoring, correctable error routes to repair), and the competence-secure versus prestige-fragile distinction is argued. Interior access in the corpus is the memory set and dialogue; the monograph infers inner state from behavior and leaves grief, guilt and moral injury open.

Risk is phase-dependent rather than a fixed recklessness score, with accelerants (endangered ally, predation, live combat, strong opponent, high-energy peers, voluntary responsibility) and brakes (nonviability, credible specialist information, legitimate wider command, exhaustion, a safer route, a peer objection introducing a new fact). Two escalation channels are distinguished by how well each is observed. Severe anger-driven overextension and grave irreversible failure are stated as less observed or open.

Ethics is modeled as enacted protection beneath a self-aware hero register, with tactical deception permitted (F6) and force framed as means rather than proof. One deliberation pattern is described (recommend preemptive force, accept a better-informed stop). The monograph leaves the severe authority-versus-justice conflict, moral injury after an unjust order and guilt after harming a protected person at C4.

Humor is described as laughter as regulation, self-parody in the hero frame, joking about inconclusive contests and deliberate teasing when she owns the frame, with the rule that the performance is playful while the ethic is sincere. No joke or line is quoted or located.

The monograph reports a bounded corpus (72 clean scenes, 276 clean narrative records, complete memory, 105 dialogue records, 9 social threads, four regional witnesses) and openly quarantines nine misjoined scenes. It carries no record IDs, scene keys or quotations for its claims, so this evidence set cannot be checked against canon without off-row files, and the corpus is Commander-heavy by the project's own warning.

Affirmative limitations are recorded rather than inferred from silence: reasoned interpretation that was manipulated (miwuzhixia), observed challenge overextension, tactical hawkishness exceeding the strategic frame, fluency loss under scripted romance, acceptance of retreat, and thirteen anti-archetype constraints. The identity quarantine is a further documented correction of the evidence base itself.

Specificity is by relationship stage and situational state, not by time. The game offers no ordered story arc for Baltimore in this evidence set, and the monograph gives no event dating; a query can select a CMD stage, not a period.

conditions: Output is illustrative and labeled noncanonical, never presented as a quotation in any locale.
The behavioral state and the CMD stage or named peer role are fixed before wording is chosen, as the monograph's operating order requires.
Locale-specific wording, honorific or first-person choices and performed-voice claims are not asserted, because the R7 and JP voice profiles are not in this evidence set.
Hero or justice language is used only in protection, confrontation, challenge or deliberate hero-play states.
scenario_readiness.note: The monograph gives per-state speech functions and negative constraints but no attested lines; generated text would be constrained in function and register direction only.

conditions: The scenario sits in the monograph's C1-C3 surfaces: practical team problems, ambiguous threats with a possibly real endangered ally, novel competitive activities with clear rules, or Commander-stage romance recombinations.
The interlocutor is the Commander at a named CMD stage or a named peer role (Bremerton, Memphis, Enterprise, Hornet); a stranger is handled as a shared-subject peer without invented history.
The weakest causally necessary component sets confidence; any C4 element (grief, grave guilt, moral injury, intimate betrayal, persistent incapacity) is output as abstention.
Output is behavioral description, not canon quotation.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: No story chronology; one named Commander relationship stage CMD0-CMD5 or a peer context, within the corpus pinned at build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The Commander at a named stage as authority, collaborator, protected principal or romantic partner; Bremerton as reciprocal-familiar peer; Memphis as analytical brake; Enterprise as respected expert; Hornet as activation amplifier; otherwise a shared-subject peer or stranger.
setting_constraints: Naval operation, port, sport, event or leisure setting comparable to the game's
A concrete objective with assessable viability
No non-Commander romance, long domestic dependency or permanent loss of capability

scenario_readiness.note: The C1-C3 map and the R8 weakest-link rule recorded in the monograph support bounded recombination; C4-C5 states end in abstention.

conditions: Activity-framed interaction (sport, practical work, food, travel, events, hosting) with the Commander or a named peer.
Public-channel decorum is kept; adult innuendo is not escalated in public.
No invented daily routine, household arrangement or friendship history beyond the named peers.
scenario_readiness.note: Baseline social ease and activity-oriented initiation are stated tendencies over a Commander-heavy corpus.

conditions: Dilemmas about protecting people or entrusted goods, use of force against a clear aggressor, retreat versus persistence, or tactical deception for protection.
A recognized wider command frame is specified; conflict between that frame and her protective justice beyond a recommendation stage ends in abstention.
No outcome after grave harm she causes to a protected person.
scenario_readiness.note: The protective ethic and the force-then-accept-a-stop pattern are modeled; severe dilemmas are C4.

conditions: The partner is the Commander at a named CMD2-CMD5 stage.
The scene states whether Baltimore owns the frame (shared doing, teasing, practiced performance) or faces a prescribed role (be cute, proper girlfriend, ceremony).
No non-Commander romantic pursuit and no long-duration domestic dependency.
scenario_readiness.note: The self-authored versus externally scripted intimacy rule and the CMD-stage asymmetry give a discriminating Commander romance model; non-Commander romance is C5.

conditions: Fleet operations, sorties, reconnaissance, rescue or public-facing event duty with specialists available.
Strategic authority is legitimate and named; she may recommend force but the model does not license unilateral escalation against it.
No formal command of a large institution and no permanent loss of combat ability.
scenario_readiness.note: Distributed-competence leadership, phase-dependent risk and acceptance of strategic authority are the monograph's best-supported surfaces.

known_limits.statement: The monograph states its claims without record IDs, scene keys or quotations; its validation and stage evidence live in R2-R8 files and audits not curated on this subject, so its warrants were not rechecked here. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

The monograph marks prolonged helplessness, sustained grief, severe guilt after harming a protected person, moral injury after an unjust order, intimate betrayal, persistent incapacity, non-Commander romance, domestic dependency and permanent loss of capability as C4 or C5, to be met with abstention.
Nine nominal Baltimore scenes (seven Musashi, two Honoka) are identity misjoins and stay excluded; the readiness score 82.91 is a frozen pre-remediation value.
The project flags the corpus as Commander-heavy, and the monograph warns that Commander-facing evidence must not define her global personality.
Moral anger is the strongest punitive accelerator, but severe anger-driven overextension is held at medium confidence; challenge activation is the clearest observed overextension.
Ear-dependent timbre is open in the monograph, and the locale and performed-voice profiles are outside this evidence set, so no locale wording or vocal quality is supported here.
